reference.title: Schema-dependent Guided controls
reference.shortdesc: Some Guided controls appear only when the selected Firefox schema supports them, including Release-only AI & smart-feature policies.

section.title: Release-supported controls
section.p: On Firefox Release 152, Step 5 can show supported AI & smart features, visual search, and smart browser feature policies when they exist in the schema.

section.title: ESR unavailable controls
section.p: On ESR 140.12, unsupported browser AI-policy controls are absent or unavailable. Do not force them into Guided editor as if they were supported.

section.title: No documentation AI functionality
section.p: This reference explains existing Firefox browser policy controls only; it does not add AI functionality to the 0.9.1 documentation portal, including RAG, embeddings, generative search, or generative answers.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If a control is missing, confirm the schema channel, check All settings for the raw support boundary, and record the unsupported state during review.
